name: Pemon
catalog_quote: Prescindiremos del acento gráfico, ya que su empleo resulta inútil en pemón al ser las palabras agudas, por regla general.

audit.action: cite a better source for the same coding
audit.reasoning: Fixed final primary stress (rule 01/001/0001...) is stated by the reference grammar (Armellada & Olza 1999, 'palabras agudas, por regla general'), derived explicitly by Alvarez 1997's instrumental metrical analysis (End Rule on the final syllable, degenerate final feet allowed, no extrametricality => primary stress always word-final), and confirmed instrumentally for the Taurepang dialect by Pessoa 2006 ('a sílaba final sempre apresenta proeminência... categórica, independente do peso'). All three are held and the quotations were verified at the stated places. The record's 'grade' and 'quote/cite/loc' top-level fields are empty even though 'dq'/'sources' carry verified quotations, so the only action is to promote the evidence grade / populate the quote fields from the held sources. sources.quote: Armellada & Olza: "We will dispense with the written accent, since its use is pointless in Pemon because words are, as a general rule, stressed on the final syllable (agudas)."
